tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (the scm_ref namelist: 37.6 N 96.7 W, start 1999-10-22 19:00 UTC, dt = 60 s, radt = 0 so radiation runs every step; GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build; data/eqwefic/scm_solthm) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 1b4b556, at the entry of SWRAD (phys/module_ra_sw.F `sw` hook, j-row 1 = call 1), which records radiation_driver's inputs xtime, gmt, julian, xlat, xlong and the outputs of radconst (declin, solcon) and calc_coszen (coszen, evaluated at xtime + radt/2 = xtime). Regime: step 1 (xtime 0, 19:00 UTC, about 12:49 local solar time): midday. Single-precision reference, rel 1e-5.

Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (the scm_ref namelist: 37.6 N 96.7 W, start 1999-10-22 19:00 UTC, dt = 60 s, radt = 0 so radiation runs every step; GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build; data/eqwefic/scm_solthm) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 1b4b556, at the entry of SWRAD (phys/module_ra_sw.F `sw` hook, j-row 1 = call 545), which records radiation_driver's inputs xtime, gmt, julian, xlat, xlong and the outputs of radconst (declin, solcon) and calc_coszen (coszen, evaluated at xtime + radt/2 = xtime). Regime: step 273 (xtime 272): the last minute before sunset, coszen +2.4e-3. Single-precision reference, rel 1e-5, with coszen bounded at abs 2e-6 because it passes through zero at this step: near sunrise and sunset the cosine moves 0.75 per radian of hour angle, and calc_coszen forms the local solar time tloctm = gmt + xt24/60 + xlon/15 (about 30 h) in REAL*4, whose 3.8e-6 h granularity is 1e-6 rad of hour angle; a float64 replay of the dumped inputs differs from the dumped coszen by up to 7.7e-7 at these crossings against 1e-8 to 1.4e-7 elsewhere.

Reference: WRF v4.8.0 SUBROUTINE radconst and SUBROUTINE calc_coszen (phys/module_radiation_driver.F:3469-3541), extracted verbatim at build time into kernels/build32/solar_kernels.F90 and driven by kernels/solar_driver.F90 of the ctessum-claude/WRF fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 1b4b556), GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build (WRF's default kinds; DEGRAD = piconst/180., DPD = 360./365. as share/module_model_constants.F:72-74). Synthetic regime, outside what the em_scm_xy reference run reaches: julian 35.25 (4 Feb 06 UTC, radconst's JULIAN < 80 branch), xtime 0, radt 0, gmt 6, 37.6 N 96.7 W: pre-dawn night. Single-precision reference, rel 1e-5.

Reference: WRF v4.8.0 SUBROUTINE radconst and SUBROUTINE calc_coszen (phys/module_radiation_driver.F:3469-3541), extracted verbatim at build time into kernels/build32/solar_kernels.F90 and driven by kernels/solar_driver.F90 of the ctessum-claude/WRF fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 1b4b556), GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build (WRF's default kinds; DEGRAD = piconst/180., DPD = 360./365. as share/module_model_constants.F:72-74). Synthetic regime, outside what the em_scm_xy reference run reaches: julian 79.9 (just below the day-80 branch point), xtime 30, radt 0, gmt 12, 51.5 N 0 E: declination within 1e-3 rad of zero, midday. Single-precision reference, rel 1e-5, except declin, bounded at abs 5e-7 rad: for JULIAN < 80 radconst forms the sun longitude as DPD (JULIAN + 285) = 359.90 degrees rather than the equivalent -0.099 degrees, and REAL*4 keeps only ~3e-5 degrees of that near-360 angle, so the Fortran declination differs from the exact value by 1.16e-7 rad (1.7e-4 relative) -- reproduced bit for bit by a NumPy float32 emulation, i.e. rounding, not a transcription difference.
